class_set: nonair truth classes present in each fixed domain, frozen before inference
classifier: raw0..13; original normalized weighted distance; first argmin
domains: (truth!=-1)&~original_mask; and intersection with fixed holdout columns
optional_physics: only after MANDATORY_COMPLETE and remaining>=4500s; max one inversion and D/32 calls
solver: unchanged Stage22 solve defaults, CPU FP64
stop: 50 consecutive relative objective changes <1e-6; final iterate
surface: existing make_surface_mask from observed flat surface; all air and immediately lower voxel
surface_distance: ASSD = mean over concatenated bidirectional nearest-boundary distance samples, 6-neighbor boundary voxels, actual physical spacing, all target components; empty -> NA
